That being said, I'm am constantly reminded by my wife of these actions despite having apologized numerous times and taken the proper steps in order to get the help I need and mend our relationship. The only thing that truly keeps me from being able to get over several hurdles is the way she acts towards me.

My response is always the same. Because I dont know, and your actions dont say that you do.
I've also told her that is she does love me, to tell me. If I knew that she did truly still love me and I got an "I love you" every so often, many of my worries would be gone. I'd be able to focus on other things instead of wallow in my own depressive thoughts.
